title: Puharich's lecture admitting work for the CIA

tellings.quote: I worked for this part of the CIA. My boss was the guy who was directly involved with all the hypnosis mind manipulation stuff.

plain: Andrija Puharich, a scientist, admitted in a lecture that he had worked for the CIA, according to a researcher on the show whose name is not given. The story dates the lecture to 1995 and places it at parapsychology conferences. The guest tells Michels that Puharich said: "I worked for this part of the CIA. My boss was the guy who was directly involved with all the hypnosis mind manipulation stuff." If true, Puharich's own work was tied to the CIA's research into hypnosis and mind control.
